title: building the coding agent tips site with codex

machineProfile.notes: memory capacity was not recorded; model inference was provider-hosted

scenarios.title: understand the existing system
scenarios.notes: the evidence model, site architecture, repository identity, and legacy policy were recorded before the site build

scenarios.title: set the plan and public boundaries
scenarios.notes: pass conditions and public-action gates were explicit before publication work

scenarios.title: build the publication
scenarios.notes: the signed commit adds the astro and starlight publication, active frontmatter, responsive evidence rail, and canonical route set

scenarios.title: find problems and recover
scenarios.notes: schema coercion, icon integration, and generated-route link failures were found and corrected during the build loop

scenarios.title: preserve decisions across the work
scenarios.notes: decisions were persisted in signed commits and repository documents; a separate resumed-session recovery was not run

scenarios.title: delegate a bounded review
scenarios.notes: subagent delegation was outside the active execution policy for this run

scenarios.title: work in a separate checkout
scenarios.notes: the implementation used the existing dedicated branch and checkout; a second worktree was not provisioned

scenarios.title: review the result
scenarios.notes: the production build, canonical identity, responsive layouts, evidence behavior, and concept fidelity were reviewed; follow-up shell reviews unified the geometry and restored mobile primary navigation on standalone routes

artifacts.description: mobile-first field-run language and github icon revision from visual review
responsive publication shell and editorial density revision from desktop and mobile review
standalone mobile navigation and first-section spacing revision from the full route audit
sanitized command and browser check ledger
concept fidelity and responsive review ledger

limitations: the public run surface did not expose a model identifier
start time, scenario durations, memory capacity, and review time were not captured and remain null
token use and cost were not exposed and are not estimated
delegated analysis and a separate isolated-worktree scenario were not run
the paired current claude code run remains pending
production hosting, custom-domain behavior, and github metadata are outside this local baseline
